newsitem.title: USA: Community Health President Smith named CEO.
newsitem.headline: Community Health President Smith named CEO.

text.p: Community Health Systems Inc said Thursday that President Wayne Smith has assumed the additional post of chief executive.
The company said E. Thomas Chaney, its co-founder and previous chief executive, will remain co-chairman with Richard Ragsdale.
The company said Smith, who joined Community Health as its president in January, had also been elected to the board.
Before joining Community Health, Smith spent 23 years at Humana Inc, most recently as president and chief operating officer.
Smith and Chaney were not available for comment.
